d: The Hornets defeated the Wizards, 110-103 tonight in Charlotte. Brandon Miller contributed a team-high 39 points to go with 6 rebounds 5 three pointers and 3 steals, with Naz Reid of the Hornets adding an additional 18 points (8-22 FG, 2-8 3P) and 12 rebounds in the game. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 29 points along with 10 rebounds for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Hornets improve their record to 3-1 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 2-2 for the season.
